Welcome to the Memorial Caverns! My name is Grayfoot. I'll be your guide through our murals as we explore the history of the pixies!

Long ago, these caverns were much larger. The pixies fled underground to escape the Cataclysm, and lived here for many years. Once we were free again, we preserved the caverns to remind ourselves not to take our beautiful world for granted!
Queen Valerian has generously helped maintain the murals you'll see on our tour today. She's continuing the long tradition of royal support for historical preservation.
The eight murals you'll see today were painted by the pixie master painter, Dego Riva.
Please follow me, and we'll take a look at the first mural.
The story begins long ago, with the Age of Harmony. The dwarves, elves, humans and pixies lived in peace, led by the Gleam Council.

The Gleam Council had many clever and powerful members. Some of the Council members were too old, too impatient, or too inexperienced, but all were concerned with the happiness and safety of our world.
Follow me, and we'll head over to the second mural.

This mural represents conflict within the Gleam Council. Some leaders believed people were happiest when they were free. Others believed the sacrifice of freedom was important to preserve peace and order. These leaders were especially worried about the uncontrolled use of magic.
Fierce arguments over the use of magic began to disrupt many Council meetings. Only a few people noticed when certain Council members stopped attending meetings altogether.
We now know they were meeting in secret. They had formed the Gloam Council.

Most of what happened is lost to history now. The Gloam Council was secretive, hidden in shadow. We know they believed that our world and people are infused with magic. By controlling magic, they believed they could control people, ensuring good behavior to keep the world safe.
You see, magic exists in everything around us, and we are all partly magical creatures. The Gloam figured out that they could control everyone by making an Artifact that controls magic.

The Gloam Council started building a powerul Artifact that would control magic... and thus control every person in the world. A few brave Gloam Council members believed this was going too far. They sent coded messages to their former colleagues on the Gleam Council to warn them.
Let's move to the fourth mural.

The Gleam Council helped every race seek shelter, to avoid being controlled by the Artifact. The humans sailed away. The dwarves ventured deep into their mountains. The pixies went underground, into these caverns.

The elves fled north after raising a magic crystal barrier, that is still standing near Snowhill. Although some dwarves and humans have returned to Sacred Grove, no elves have been seen in many, many years.

Not everyone took shelter, though. A few people of every race simply couldn't get out in time. Others wanted to stay and defend their homes. And a small group of heroes came together to destroy the Artifact, which leads us to the fifth mural. Follow me!

It takes tremendous power to create a device to control all of the magic. The heroes knew the destroying the Artifact might release that power into the world. There was a long and difficult battle against the Gloam forces, but the Gleam heroes prevailed.
The heroes destroyed the Artifact in an act now called The Unbinding. A massive wave of pure power washed over the land, decimating everything in its path. Now, on to the next mural!
The races who fled or went underground were safe. The pixies lived in these caverns for a long time.
Every few years, a few adventurers would head up to the surface to check, but the world was barren and lifeless.

One day, a strange new kind of pixie came into the caverns. He had lost his wings, and it looked like he had somehow merged with other creatures. He told a tale of heartache and loss, and the life he and others of his kind lived on the barren wastes above.
The great pixie Queen Ayani met with this strange pixie. She discovered that pixies who did not take shelter were forever changed by the Unbinding. These are what we now call Changelings.
Please follow me to the next mural.

Queen Ayani was a child during the Cataclysm. She still remembered how beautiful the world was before the Unbinding. The plight of the Changelings, and the destruction of her world, broke Ayani's heart.
Against the wishes of her companions, Queen Ayani went to the surface to see for herself what had become of her world. When she saw the devastation, she began to cry.
As Ayani cried, her tears began to form rivers. Where the rivers touched, new life began to form and our world began to heal. The pixies gradually returned to the surface to rebuild.
Let's go see the last mural.

Ayani never again left that place. It was the founding of our current capital city, which she named Sanctuary in memory of the sheltering caverns below. When Ayani eventually passed on, they buried her at that spot, at the center of what is now called The Lake of Tears.
A few days after they buried Ayani, the pixies noticed a tree sprouting from her grave. It grew larger and larger, forming the Heartseed in the caverns below, and the World Tree up above.

Together, the Heartseed and World Tree form the centerpiece of pixie culture. They are a reminder of the sacrifices made by great pixies in the past to preseve freedom and life for everyone in these lands. Our current queen, Valerian, is the royal protector of the Heartseed.

I hope you've enjoyed this look into pixie history. Please stop by Fhred's souvenir stand in the caverns below, since all proceeds help preserve the caverns and these lovely murals. Follow me if you would like to return to the entrance. Have a great day!

You want to know about the Crew? I'm working right now, so I'll just give you the facts. Poe, Shifty, Ari, and Maple formed the Cardie Crew. There was never any jealousy among the bunch, until Shifty suggested Ari couldn't beat Maple at her own deck.

Ari's ego got the best of her. She switched to playing a nature deck and challenged Maple. The defeat that followed was too much for Ari. She ran off toward Lavender Coast while Shifty happily watched the Crew disband.

Back in the day, duelists could only play one deck. Sheldon convinced Ari to play a nature deck, same as Maple Sugarleaf. She wanted to be the best, and lost.

Alright! I know you all want to hear the story of how we fairies came to be.
The story of the fairies begins a long time ago, when this land was still young and her people were just beginning to open their eyes...
This gently waking world was, one day, assailed by the torrents of a great rain storm.
The rain fell from the sky for days upon days, soaking the earth and swelling the rivers so that they spilled over onto their banks.
Some people thought the rain would never end, but one day the clouds broke and the sun shone through.
There in the middle of everything was an enormous rainbow.
This rainbow did not vanish when the water dried and the clouds cleared; no, it remained, rippling in vibrant colors.
At the base of this rainbow, a cluster of flowers popped up and out of the ground.
For a long time, the flowers remained closed tightly, gently nestling what lay inside.
When the flowers finally bloomed, their golden petals slowly uncurled to reveal faces like the sun, and within each one, a fairy was curled.
The skin of the fairies was the colors of the rainbow itself. You see, that is why we live near this rainbow, and why we tend to these sunflowers carefully and with reverence.

Their intention was pure - maintaining peace throughout the realm. This period of time was known as the Age of Harmony.
This new group wanted to control everyone, inferring they were best suited to tell people how to live their lives. This was the beginning of the Gloam Council.
Since all living things had some amount of magic within them, they could practically control the world. The plan worked, but for a minor flaw - not everyone succumbed to the artifact's control.
A few powerful heroes of the day were able to protect themselves from the Binding, banding together in secrecy to plan the artifact's destruction.
Battling through unwitting mobs and powerful wizards, the heroes combined their powers breaching the magical defenses and shattering the artifact's physical shell.
This resulted in the Unbinding, which freed the people, but sent a tidal wave of magic across the lands.
As years passed, the pixies transformed the dark forlorn cave into a warm, cheery home.
Everyone assumed that there was no life left above, content to stay in the caves forever. That is, until the changelings arrived.
As the queen, Ayani the Druidess decided she would venture forth alone and brave the world above.
However, when she flitted out of the caves, she saw nothing but desolation as far as the eye could see. Gone were the flowers and the trees and everything else she remembered as a child.
Seeing this miracle, other pixies emerged, and coaxed life back into the land.
When Ayani passed, she left behind the Heartseed. With the royal family nurturing it, the Heartseed grew into the mighty World Tree, the center of the pixie's world.
